title: Cancel subscription
body: How do I cancel the subscription? There is no clear way to do it
author: Honest_biaaatchhh

title: I feel cheated.
body:
I had written several emails asking to cancel the subscription and after 10 emails with replies received after many days, they did not cancel the subscription. 
When I asked for a refund they did not do it but they assured that there will be no new charge. 
Useless product 
Very bad customer service 
Don't buy it they will make you continuous unjustified charges
author: Jenninaina
